ko: 닿을 수 없고 오를 수 없네
en: We could not reach, we could not climb, We were under the power of death
In despair we looked up to heaven,When I called upon Your name
Breaking through the darkness, Your loveShines upon my soul,
Lord, You have already accomplished all things,Jesus, my living hope
Your great mercy cannot be described,Your endless grace cannot be expressed
To bear my sin and my shame,You came down to this earth
Through Your cross You saved me,You made me a child of the King
Forever I belong to You,Jesus, my living hope
Hallelujah, we praise Your holy name,Hallelujah, You have set me free
You broke the curse of sin,Savior of salvation, Your name,Jesus, my living hope
The morning when the covenant was fulfilled,The breath of the Lord began
The Lion of Judah who conquered death, Our Lord has risen again, Jesus has won the victory
